The '''''Vengeance''-class dreadnought''' was a [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnought]]-scale [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Characteristics==
===Dimensions===
[[File:Vengeance_command_tower.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Vengeance'' class's command tower.]]
The ''Vengeance''-class was based on the standard Super Star Destroyer design, the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class]].<ref name="ROTFN" /> As such, the ship class was approximately 19 kilometers long. In addition, because of its dimensions, the ship class sometimes possessed the standard classification of a [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="SOTG07" />

In contrast with the ''Executor''-class, the ''Vengeance''-class's frame was supplied with a slender build, more narrow than standard Star Destroyers, almost sword-like in comparison to the usual dagger shape.<ref name="JK:DFII" />

The ''Vengeance''-class's height contrasted its length, which was little more than 150 meters and with downward sloping armor dominating most of the dorsal frame. The ship class's bridge was extensive, but also covered much of the command tower, unlike most other KDY warship classes.<ref name="JK:DFII" /> It is known that it was one of the larger Super Star Destroyers of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], and its length (exceeding 5,000 meters) put it firmly in the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] category.<ref name="SW:CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref><ref name="EGW" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
[[File:Vengeancestern.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''Vengeance''-class's array of engines.]]
The ''Vengeance'' was only shown defeating a small, probably unmanned [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]],<ref name="JK:DFII" /> but the ship class it belonged to had armaments similar to Star Dreadnoughts of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class]].<ref name="SOTG07" />

===Propulsion systems===
The ''Vengeance''-class had a cluster of engines, consisting of three primary engines, two secondary engines flanking the vessel and six auxiliary engines clustering around the primary ones.<ref name="JK:DFII" />

===Complement===
Little is known about the capabilities of the ''Vengeance''-class, except that they carried a number of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttles]].<ref name="DF:RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

===Command bridge===
The ''Vengeance''-class was unique in that it lacks the standard Kuat Drive Yards-style wedge shaped command bridge tower. Instead, the command bridge is located on a small square ridge near the stern of the ship.<ref name="JK:DFII" /> It shared this trait with the [[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor Mark II''-class battlecruiser]].

==History==
[[File:Byss_fleet2.jpg|thumb|left|''Vengeance''-class dreadnoughts around Byss]]
The ''Vengeance''-class was one of several heavy [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] classes made after the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]].<ref name="EGW" />

The [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] was a dreadnought of this class named the [[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|''Vengeance'']]. It was used from some time before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Saga6" /> to the time of his death in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="JK:DFII" /> Several ''Vengeance''-class dreadnoughts were apparently utilized by the [[Byss Defense Fleet]].<ref name="DE4">[[Dark Empire 4|''Dark Empire'' 4]]</ref>

Three ''Vengeance''s anchored massive task forces sent from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] to reconquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. One of which, the [[Javelin (Vengeance-class)|''Javelin'']], was destroyed during the subsequent [[Imperial Civil War]] when its captain steered it into a [[Unidentified Torpedo Sphere (Chasin)|Torpedo Sphere]] that guarded [[Chasin]].<ref name="EGW" />

[[File:Vengeance_SotG.jpg|200px|thumb|A ''Vengeance''-class vessel from behind.]]

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Vengeance''-class dreadnought first appeared in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', alongside a ship within its class, the ''Javelin''. Although artwork of it was never shown, the name of the ship class suggested a connection to Jerec's flagship [[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|of the same name]]. A post made by [[Paul R. Urquhart]] on the TEGTW forum for TheForce.Net revealed that the similarities and connections between the ship class and Jerec's ship was intentional.<ref name="McEwok">{{JCFCite|temp=yes|url=posts/84148|board=Expanded Universe|thread=Lit - BE EXCITED: The Essential Thread to The Essential Guide to Warfare|user=[[Paul R. Urquhart|Thrawn McEwok]]|date=2012-04-30|nobackup=1}}</ref>

In his concept art for an unused command ship for [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], [[James Clyne]] illustrated a design that greatly resembles the ''Vengeance''-class.<ref name="Art of TROS">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref>
